verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gmail has a REST API reference that documents methods and endpoints, such as users.messages.send and watch. Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples (an in-page 'try it' explorer or executable samples). A static reference is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
